side_balance.rule: The cap is applied per cell type and side. In the hop the cap trims, each cell type's left and right candidates are ranked by path strength. First, the strongest candidates on the type's short side that even out its neurons already kept at earlier hops are single units; the rest are paired by rank, the strongest left with the strongest right. A type's surplus on one side has no partner and is not kept. Neurons on neither side (center, unknown) are single units. Units are kept in order of their weakest member's path strength (ties: lower FlyWire ID) until the next unit would exceed the cap. Seeds, direct partners and hops the cap does not trim are kept as they are, so their own imbalance remains.
side_balance.note: applied: the cap bound, so the hop it trims was chosen per cell type and side; otherwise nothing changed
